featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
The history of this club is interesting, but its current policy is total nonsense. This club is strictly meant only for life members and their descendants. While I personally have no involvement with this, they should at least mention this crucial fact on their website.
​I recently moved from Sion to Tardeo, and after searching online, I visited this club today as it was the nearest swimming pool. However, the watchman informed me that membership is strictly hereditary, intended only for blood relatives. He also stated that no new memberships have been granted since 1995.
​This situation is truly disgusting because they fail to mention this restriction online. I assume that countless people must have visited over the years, only to leave disappointed. This current owner/s' mentality is extremely poor—it's a form of harassment for non-members, perhaps seeking publicity or some perverse pleasure.
​If that is not the case, they must immediately update their website with this fact. Doing so would prevent the wastage of time and harassment of non-members.

featured_reviews.name: Sohil Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Young Men’s Christian Association (YMCA) is a well-known institution that provides a variety of professional and skill-based courses, including computer training programs. It has built a strong reputation for offering quality education at affordable fees, making it a popular choice among students and working individuals.

The computer course at YMCA is designed to cater to both beginners and advanced learners. The syllabus is well-structured and covers important topics such as basic computer operations, MS Office, internet applications, programming languages, and other relevant software. The course is regularly updated according to current industry requirements, which helps students stay competitive in the job market

Another positive aspect is the reasonable fee structure compared to other private institutes. The certification provided after course completion is valuable and recognized, which helps students in getting job opportunities.

However, there is still some scope for improvement, such as extending lab hours for extra practice and introducing more advanced and specialized courses

featured_reviews.name: Amir Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Team  - YMCA Procter Branch Mumbai,

Today was the final day of my two-month training, and I could not let it pass without thanking the entire team.
I would like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team of YMCA Procter Branch Swimming Training Branch for providing such an excellent training experience over the last two months.

A very special thanks to Amul Raj Sir, Sebastian Paul Sir ,Peter Sir, Rashid Sir, Sadique Sir, Ashim Sir, Mr. Ali, Mr. Huzefa, and also to the Office Staff, caretakers, reception(Mr. Patil & Mr. Sudhir ) & housekeeping staff.

The entire team is truly excellent in both their work and their attitude, consistently creating a positive and motivating environment for all learners.

The program has been extremely well-structured, and I truly appreciate the dedication, support, and professionalism shown by all the coaches and staff.

Each one of them has contributed immensely—not just in teaching swimming techniques but also in creating an environment where beginners like me felt comfortable, confident, and motivated.

The trainers’ patience, personal attention, and continuous encouragement helped me overcome aquaphobia and learn to swim with confidence.

As a kidney transplant recipient who is grateful to have completed a decade post-surgery today (16th August 2025), I never imagined in my dreams that I could take up swimming. Yet, this journey has shown me that with the right guidance, patience, and encouragement, even the most distant goals can become achievable.

However, the coaches handled my case with utmost care, calmly guiding me through my skill gaps, correcting me on every dive, and advising me with patience.

While I have gained significant knowledge and comfort in swimming to the best of my physical ability, I am now motivated to further enhance my skills and continue this journey with YMCA Procter branch.

I must also mention that the pool facilities are maintained exceptionally well—clean, hygienic, and welcoming round the clock—which adds to the overall positive experience.

I would be delighted to continue my swimming journey with the YMCA Procter branch and further enhance my skills, progressing at a pace that aligns with my personal fitness and well-being.

Thank you once again to the entire YMCA Procter family for your dedication and warmth. I look forward to being part of your sessions again soon.

Warm regards,
Aamir

pure sports club without the oomph of other' clubs in South Mumbai, you shall be lucky to have a dad who bought you this memberships. Views to die for. Has a beach touch location, practically a private beach, has boating section in a Lagoon kinda water, good for amateur level water sports, club facilitates rowing, kayaking, canoeing, windsurfing, water-skiing, speed boats, probably only club in India have this facility with least entry tariff barriers. Two different swimming pools, male n females, with steam and sauna facilities of Olympic size pools hosting district n state level swimming n diving competitions. Has a Volleyball game court. Should be only club to have a Boat Club, kinda of a private beach enterance to a lagoon kinda sea waters. Probably the only club which would have a full different pool for the females. featured_reviews.review_text:
Lovely place to spend a Sunday chilling by the pool and enjoying their barbeque and drinks. A members only club with a long history and two pools, one sweet water and another salt water which is shaped similar in looking to the map of India.
The bbq is great, they have grilled prawns, or chicken or fish or beef to choose from! Loads of salads and other stuff as accompaniments. Unfortunately unless one knows someone who is a member, entry is next to impossible. I am just a lucky chap to know someone who signs us in and do enjoy the lazy Sunday's there. The advantage of clubs is that it's inexpensive and considering the meal costs in Bombay restaurants, it's fantastic. The other advantage of this club is that it's not as stuffy as the other ones. If you have a friend with a membership get them to take you there, it's worth a visit! Especially with its chequered past!

featured_reviews.review_text: One of the oldest clubs in Mumbai -  devoted to swimming although they do have a few tennis courts now. An exclusive club,  open only to members. There's a cozy bar-cum-cafeteria which serves meals and substantial snacks -like steak burgers - indoors in air-conditioning or in a meshed-in verandah overlooking the outdoor pool. Finish off your meal or quick bite of choice with a double espresso-on-twin-scoops of vanilla ice cream, liberally sprinkled with shaved almonds. Visiting Mumbai? Don't forget to get in touch with a member friend!

featured_reviews.name: Лилия
featured_reviews.review_text:
After receiving multiple advertisements for swimming classes at Michael Phelps, I enrolled my child in a trial class, eager to see if it would be a good fit for our family. However, after the trial class, I was informed that the school is fully booked and cannot accommodate my child in the regular sessions.

This experience has been frustrating and very misleading. It is disappointing to realize that despite the time and effort spent attending the trial class, there was no possibility of enrolling my child in your program due to the lack of available spots. This crucial information was not communicated to us beforehand, this should be clearly stated prior to booking trial classes.

Advertising trial classes when there are no available spots for regular enrollment is fraudulent and unprofessional. It creates false hopes and wastes valuable time for both parents and children.

I urge you to review this and ensure that clear and transparent communication is provided in the future. Prospective clients should be informed of the availability of spots before enrolling in any trial classes to avoid such disappointments.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We regret the inconvenience you faced. Nevertheless it may be that the spot of your choice wasn't available at the time of your trial. We will try our best to improve the experience for our clients.Many thanks for your feedback.

1) The coaches very well understand how to handle the kids and encourage them
2) My kid has overcome the fear of swimming in just a few sessions
3) Individual attention as coach and student ratio of 1:6 is followed
4) The progress of every child is monitored on a regular basis. So the parents also get to know how much a child has learnt.

featured_reviews.name: Ryan Rodricks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been here numerous times for swim meets and various events.

The 50M pool is very well maintained, clean and proper demarcation of lanes. Has a full 7 lanes with the 1st and 7th being extra wide.

Has a 5M diving board for diving facilities.

Clean and well kept wash amd changing rooms are provided.

Gets very crowded on weekends and holidays. Especially in the summer.

Coaching facilities are provided and has numerous staff on hand for any swimming and coaching requirements.

The canteen is a bit lacking in food and taste but does provide tea/coffee and light snacks.

The seating arrangements need improvement which is where I deducted 1 star. The seats are hard narrow and cramped and very little space to move or walk around.

Overall one of the best and well maintained pools in the suburbs and maintenance and cleanliness standards are very high.

featured_reviews.name: Rajiv
featured_reviews.review_text:
Really a very nice pool managed by BMC.
It is a 50 metre olympics size pool which conducts training and hosts various interschool, district and state level events.

Apart from this they maintain a small pool for kids as well.

The Name is OZONE because they maintain Ozonized water in the pool.

The yearly training fee is very much affordable for a normal family as well. They just charge RS. 6800/- as regular fell and almost 1000/- extra for learners. Rs 18/- they charge as daily locker fee and one may opt for a yearly fee of RS 700.

45 mins slot and government staff approach is another prospect where you may feel little disappointed 😞☹️
Parking is also a concern here.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Tondwalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ozone has two swimming pool. One for the kids and one for proper swimming.
The swimming pool is ozonized and it is well maintained.  There are many life guards for the safety of its members. The pool has maximum depth of 18 feet.

The pools water is really nice and it is one of the cleanest pools in the locality. As a swimmer one can get yearly membership at 6764/- and for learners it is extra 1000/-.

One member has to select one of the batches available and then has to come only during that particular batch only.  There is no particular parking space for two / four wheeler so one has to park on the road at their own risk.

Locker facility is available at 18/- per day basis or a yearly fee if 720/-.

featured_reviews.name: Shankar Chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Have joined the last summer camp with my daughter in Ozone swimming pool, near vivek college, Goregaon west. Have taken morning batch from 9 am to 10 am. The pool is open from morning 9 am to evening 7 pm. Open for all ages. The trainers are good here. The pool has different sizes, it start from 3 feet to 18 feet. Now a days me and my daughter is using floaters for swimming 🏊‍♀️. The morning time is little busy. Can take yearly membership for Rs 7000.
